# P-8 · Mission or Business Focus

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Step | P Prepare (system level) |
| Phases | PH-MSA (primary) |
| Depends on | P-2 |
| Inputs | ART-ORG-CONTEXT, EXT-CAPDOC, EXT-PRODUCT, EXT-ORG-POLICY |
| Outputs | ART-BIA (produces) |
| Writes facts | missions |
| Minimum interviews | 1 |
| RACI | R: PER-SPONSOR · A: PER-PM · C: PER-AO, PER-IO, PER-UR, PER-CIO, PER-CISO, PER-PRIV · I: PER-ISSM · PER-PRIV only when the system processes PII |
| Persona cards | [PER-SPONSOR](../../personas/PER-SPONSOR.md), [PER-PM](../../personas/PER-PM.md), [PER-AO](../../personas/PER-AO.md), [PER-IO](../../personas/PER-IO.md), [PER-UR](../../personas/PER-UR.md), [PER-CIO](../../personas/PER-CIO.md), [PER-CISO](../../personas/PER-CISO.md), [PER-PRIV](../../personas/PER-PRIV.md) |

Purpose: Identify the missions, business functions and mission/business processes the system will support, so that categorization and requirements trace to mission impact.

## Steps

1. **Entry check.** Run `uv run rmf status <run>`: P-8 is the next action, and
   P-2 is done or out of scope.
   Entry criteria (from `framework/tasks/P.yaml`):
   - A capability need is documented (EXT-CAPDOC) and the organizational context is available.
   - The program has entered its pathway at its first decision point - the Materiel Development Decision on major capability acquisition; receipt of a validated UON, an approved critical warfighter issue statement or an RAA determination on urgent capability acquisition; an approved CNS on the software pathway; the validated services requirement on an acquisition of services.
   If one is not met, stop and journal a NOTE (`00-run-protocol.md`, stop conditions). Why:
   the task builds on those results, and working around a gap leaves claims nobody can
   trace.
2. **Read the inputs** listed in `## Inputs`, and the passages in `## Citations` that say
   what P-8 must achieve. The purpose in the header states the outcome.
   P-8 feeds MS-A (Milestone A, milestone); what it
   records must be ready for that event.
   Why: the playbook is generic, so the inputs and the cited text set the content.
3. **Interview** following `_shared/interviewing.md` (and `_shared/hybrid-mode.md` in a
   `hybrid` run). Start with the responsible (R) personas in `## Interviews`. Take the
   questions from each persona card's `## Question bank by step` for step P
   (Prepare) and point them at what the exit criteria in `## Done when` need and the
   inputs leave open.
   Write at least 1 interview file(s) with `task: P-8`.
   Why: answers are the evidence that artifacts cite (`INT-###.A#`).
4. **Write the outputs** in `## Outputs`, each file whole (INV-8), every claim traced per
   `_shared/tagging-and-traceability.md`:
   - **ART-BIA** (Business impact and criticality analysis): Whether mission critical functions are present within the system and which, the mission and business processes it supports with the impact of their disruption, the users' recovery time requirements and interdependencies, the external stakeholders that depend on them, and the reevaluations by the mission and data owners that a conflict with the categorization triggers. Made at P-8 so the tasks that read a business impact or criticality analysis have one before S-4, where the contingency plan BIA refines it.
     Read `templates/artifacts/ART-BIA.md`, replace every `<<FILL: ...>>` placeholder, delete the template
     comment, and write `artifacts/ART-BIA.md` with `produced_by_task: P-8` and
     `touched_by: [P-8]`.
     Write `artifacts/data/bia.yaml` whole (schema `framework/schema/bia.schema.json`, template `templates/data/bia.yaml`); summarize its records in the Markdown by ID instead of copying them.
   Why: `rmf status` counts P-8 done only when every output lists it in `touched_by`.
5. **Write the facts** in `## Facts`: rewrite `facts.yaml` whole, keeping every field
   other tasks wrote, with `set_by_task: P-8` and the answers in `sources`.
6. **Build and check.** `uv run rmf build <run>`, then `uv run rmf check <run> --task P-8`,
   until 0 errors (INV-6).
7. **Journal** a CHECKPOINT (`## Journal and lessons`).

## Interviews

| Persona | Role | Interview |
|---|---|---|
| PER-SPONSOR (Capability / Requirements Sponsor) | R | start here |
| PER-PM (Program Manager / System Owner) | A | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-AO (Authorizing Official) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-IO (Information Owner / Steward) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-UR (User Representative) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-CIO (DoD Component Chief Information Officer) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-CISO (DoD Component Chief Information Security Officer) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-PRIV (Component Privacy Officer) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |

At least 1 interview(s) with `task: P-8`. Never make a persona answer
outside its role; ask the persona who would know, or record an assumption.

## Inputs

- ART-ORG-CONTEXT (Organizational risk context): `artifacts/ART-ORG-CONTEXT.md`, `artifacts/data/org-context.yaml`, `artifacts/data/scrm-org.yaml`
- EXT-CAPDOC (Capability requirements documents): files in the run's product directory, cited as
  `product/<path>#<anchor>`.
- EXT-PRODUCT (Product material): files in the run's product directory, cited as
  `product/<path>#<anchor>`.
- EXT-ORG-POLICY (Organizational policy and Prepare-step guidance): the product directory, when the fork supplies it there;
  otherwise ask the responsible persona, and record an assumption for what nobody can
  answer.
- Only these: do not open other run files (`00-run-protocol.md`, step 4).

| Field | Set by |

## Done when

- Missions, business functions and mission/business processes that the system is intended to support are identified (DoDI 8510.01 Table 1 outcome).
- Interviews record the supported missions and mission/business processes, citable by P-9, P-10 and C-1.
- facts.yaml `missions` (from framework 0.2.0) lists each mission, business function and mission/business process with its kind and whether it is mission essential, identified by the mission or business owner; an essential function names its supporting assets and data once P-11 and P-12 put them on record (MSN-001).
- artifacts/data/bia.yaml records whether mission critical functions are present and which, and each supported process with the impact of its disruption, the users' recovery time requirement and its interdependencies (BIA-001).
- `artifacts/ART-BIA.md` lists P-8 in `touched_by` and has `produced_by_task: P-8`.
- At least 1 interview(s) with `task: P-8`.
- `uv run rmf check <run> --task P-8` reports 0 errors.

## Journal and lessons

- CHECKPOINT: `## <time> · CHECKPOINT · task P-8`, naming what the outputs now hold.
